description: Backend Layer 1: add Sindhi (sd) and Balochi (bal) to complaint-language understanding. Self-contained, independent of FEAT-002/003 except the ai_pipeline.py string edits are additive and must not disturb multi-item logic. Grounded in nlp_rules.py (detect_language, BASIC_NUMBER_WORDS, parse_word_numbers compound_hundreds, generate_native_acknowledgment) and ai_pipeline.py (COMPLAINT_ITEM_SCHEMA, FEW_SHOT_SYSTEM_PROMPT).
steps: Re-read awaaz_backend/services/nlp_rules.py. In detect_language(), inside the Arabic-script branch, AFTER the Pashto-unique-letter check and BEFORE `return "Urdu"`, add: if any char in ['ڄ','ٺ','ٽ','ڻ','ڱ','ڳ','ڦ','ڀ','ٿ','ڏ'] return "Sindhi" (these do not appear in Urdu/Punjabi-Shahmukhi). Add a comment that Arabic-script Balochi has no unique code points and may fall through to "Urdu" (accepted).

In the Latin-script section of detect_language(), add short high-precision sindhi_patterns (e.g. \bmaan\b, \btawhan\b/\btuhan\b, \baahe\b/\baahy\b, \bkahro\b, \bghani\b — avoid shared qeemat/bazar) and balochi_patterns (e.g. \bmani\b, \btaw\b/\btau\b, \bint\b/\bent\b, \bgran\b), checked in order English -> Sindhi -> Balochi -> Punjabi -> Pashto -> Roman Urdu. Keep lists short so existing test_language_detection cases still pass. Mark both lists with a # NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED comment.

Add Sindhi/Balochi romanized number words to BASIC_NUMBER_WORDS only where they differ from existing keys (do/teen/sau/hazaar/char/panch already present). Suggested Balochi: yak(1),du(2),sai(3),shash(6),hapt(7),hasht(8),nuh(9),dah(10),sad(100); Sindhi: hik(1),ba(2),tei(3). Mirror any new 1-9 prefixes into the compound_hundreds list inside parse_word_numbers(). Mark # NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED. Do not duplicate existing dict keys.

Add elif language == "Sindhi": and elif language == "Balochi": branches to generate_native_acknowledgment() BEFORE the Roman-Urdu else, returning the DRAFT native strings from language-support-design.md section 2.1c (Sindhi: 'توهان جي شڪايت درج ٿي وئي آهي…', Balochi: 'شمے شکایت درج بوت…'), each with a # DRAFT — NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED comment and Roman gloss.

Re-read awaaz_backend/ai_pipeline.py. Change COMPLAINT_ITEM_SCHEMA.detected_language.description to 'Detected language (Urdu, Roman Urdu, Punjabi, Sindhi, Balochi, Pashto, English)'. In FEW_SHOT_SYSTEM_PROMPT add Sindhi+Balochi to the enumerated input-languages sentence and append one Sindhi and one Balochi few-shot example in the multi-item {"items":[...]} shape per design 2.2b, flagged as drafts. String-only, additive — do NOT touch parse_complaint_items/_call_ollama_llm_multi/_segment_clauses logic.

Extend awaaz_backend/tests/test_nlp_rules.py: add Sindhi-script + Sindhi/Balochi Roman assertions to test_language_detection; add a Sindhi/Balochi number assertion (e.g. parse_word_numbers('du sau rupay') contains '200'); add assertions that generate_native_acknowledgment('Sindhi') and ('Balochi') return non-empty Arabic-script strings.
acceptance_criteria: detect_language returns 'Sindhi' for Sindhi-script text containing the unique letters and for the Sindhi Roman markers; Balochi Roman markers return 'Balochi'.
generate_native_acknowledgment('Sindhi') and ('Balochi') return non-empty native-script strings.
COMPLAINT_ITEM_SCHEMA.detected_language.description and FEW_SHOT_SYSTEM_PROMPT enumerate Sindhi and Balochi; two new few-shot examples present.
Existing test_language_detection, test_punjabi_and_pashto_numbers, test_native_acknowledgment still pass.
No module-load import of openai-whisper, PyAV av, or tiktoken introduced; whisper stays lazy.
verification: From awaaz_backend: .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_nlp_rules.py -v  (all existing + new assertions pass)
From awaaz_backend: .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/ -q  (full backend suite green; confirms ai_pipeline.py import + JSON-shape unchanged)
findings: Backend now recognizes 'Sindhi' and 'Balochi' as detect_language() return values (in addition to Urdu, Roman Urdu, Punjabi, Pashto, English). Frontend/other features that key behavior on detected_language (e.g. ReportSection RTL/font check, currently detected_language==='Urdu') must treat Sindhi and Balochi as RTL Arabic-script too. All new Sindhi/Balochi strings and markers carry a greppable 'NATIVE-REVIEW-REQUIRED' (nlp_rules.py: detect_language sindhi/balochi marker lists, BASIC_NUMBER_WORDS additions, compound_hundreds additions) or 'DRAFT' (generate_native_acknowledgment Sindhi/Balochi branches, ai_pipeline.py few-shot examples) comment. New number words added to BASIC_NUMBER_WORDS: yak,hik(1), du,ba(2), sai,tei(3), shash(6), hapt(7), hasht(8), nuh(9), dah(10), sad(100). 'du' and the Sindhi/Balochi 1-9 prefixes (yak,hik,ba,sai,tei,shash,hapt,hasht,nuh) + hundred word 'sad' were mirrored into parse_word_numbers compound_hundreds so '<prefix> sau/sad' resolves. New test: tests/test_nlp_rules.py::test_sindhi_and_balochi_numbers; test_language_detection and test_native_acknowledgment extended with Sindhi/Balochi assertions. ai_pipeline.py COMPLAINT_ITEM_SCHEMA.detected_language.description widened and FEW_SHOT_SYSTEM_PROMPT gained one Sindhi + one Balochi {"items":[...]} example. Arabic-script Balochi detection is intentionally weak (no unique code points) and may fall through to 'Urdu' — accepted limitation. Verified: pytest tests/test_nlp_rules.py (8 passed) and full suite tests/ (48 passed). Whisper import remains lazy; no module-load openai-whisper/av/tiktoken introduced.
